svg.aria-label: Chapter VI, The Sealed Door. A massive arched door between two torch-lit columns, iron-banded, a skull keystone, carved skulls and the words ONE ORDER. In its centre a round stone seal holds three empty gem sockets in a row, a carved question mark under each. Xal'Zor, now an ally, shines his eye on the seal. The ape paladin and the three constructs stand on the left; Brakka and Gus the gelatinous cube, with three loose gems tumbling inside him, stand on the right.
